fixed: medium (900px): the auth gate had no interactive control to retry when Sign in with Apple setup fails — only red text telling the user to reload. Added a calm 'Last inn på nytt' reload button, shown only on an auth error, resolving the dead end.
notes: The two HIGH findings (dashboard hidden behind the mandatory 'Logg på med Apple' wall; AUTHENTICATION_FAILED) were deliberately NOT actioned: the gate is an explicit owner decision (eier-beslutning 21.07, documented inline in index.html; body.gated hides all content until Sign in with Apple succeeds). Removing/bypassing it would reverse an owner decision. The failure to reach the board here is also an artifact of the offline screenshot harness having no network to Apple CloudKit — visual-qa itself flagged this and asked a human to confirm real signed-in users see the dashboard in production.

The MEDIUM finding IS genuinely code-fixable and independent of the gate decision: on any auth error (CloudKit failed to load, or setUpAuth rejected — e.g. blocked third-party cookies / private browsing, a real production scenario) the user was left with red text instructing a reload but no control. Added #auth-retry: static markup in index.html, revealed by icloud-sync.js gate() showError() (created on demand for gate-boot's injected overlay on secondary pages), hidden again on the normal gate and after successful auth. Its only action is location.reload() — exactly what the error copy already instructs. Quiet secondary button (--surface bg, --line border, amber only on hover) — respects calm design, not an accent.

Unlike the 2026-07-28 deferral (which treated 'any change to the auth flow' as unverifiable because the AUTHED board needs a live CloudKit sign-in the harness lacks), this change is confined to the ERROR STATE — which is exactly what the offline harness renders — plus a single guarded hideRetry() on the success path that only hides an already-hidden button. The authed-board render is untouched. So the fix is fully screenshot-verifiable here.

Screenshot-verified at 375/393/900px: the reload button appears centered and calm below the error, no overflow/truncation, wordmark + tagline + lead copy intact — no regression. npm test: 1207 passed (73 files).
